title: Ground State Solutions For Local-Nonlocal Shrodinger Equations In the Presence Of Two Critical Exponents
summary: In this paper, we address the existence of ground state solutions for Schrodinger equations in the presence of local and nonlocal operators and two critical nonlinearities associated with each operator. The situation is completely solved in the critical case both in the local and in the nonlocal settings. However, methods developed in these cases cannot extend to local-nonlocal operators when we have two critical power nonlinearities.
